subject.title: fix: make Back work within channel setup

question: Should `beforePersistentEffect` be the supported plugin setup contract that adapters must call before their first durable operation, thereby defining the terminal Back-navigation boundary?
rationale: The patch is mechanically coherent, but choosing an optional adapter callback as the long-lived boundary affects plugin compatibility and future setup implementations; code review cannot determine whether maintainers want this convention or a more centralized contract.

options.title: Approve the adapter boundary
options.body: Accept `beforePersistentEffect` as the plugin setup lifecycle contract, then merge after the current-base refresh confirms the documented built-in/custom-adapter coverage.

options.title: Centralize the boundary first
options.body: Pause this branch and redesign the setup API so the coordinator can enforce persistence boundaries without relying on each adapter to opt in.

recommendation.title: Approve the adapter boundary
recommendation.body: Accept `beforePersistentEffect` as the plugin setup lifecycle contract, then merge after the current-base refresh confirms the documented built-in/custom-adapter coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent channel setup and plugin-install work makes this contributor the closest available routing candidate for the contract discussion.
